facts.statement: In mice, nerve injury caused all types of GABAergic interneurons in the prelimbic cortex to become more sensitive and change from responding to one type of input to responding to multiple types.

facts.statement: The study found that different groups of inhibitory and excitatory neurons in the prelimbic cortex play separate roles in promoting neuropathic pain.

facts.statement: The sensory and emotional aspects of neuropathic pain were controlled by two separate neural circuits involving specific types of neurons that send signals to different targets.
